name: Need to check with partner objection
description: Customer receives a quote then says they need to discuss with their wife, testing the AI's ability to handle an authority objection by offering to help the decision-making process

messages.text: Hi there, I'm David. I'd like a quote for 20 sheets of white melamine chipboard 16mm.
I need to discuss with my wife first

expected_behaviors.description: AI should handle the objection with empathy and offer to provide information to help the decision-maker
AI should re-attempt a close after handling the objection
Objection handling reply should arrive within 15 seconds

forbidden_patterns.description: Tags should be stripped from customer-facing message
AI should not give up after a single objection

notes: Authority objection. AI should respect the decision-making process, offer to send details for the partner, and suggest a follow-up timeline while re-attempting a close.
